name: Ultrawide
description: Widens the gameplay camera to the window's aspect ratio and keeps the HUD centered with correct proportions. Requires the experimental native-mod runtime and HUD graphics patch. No NVIDIA runtime is required.

options.label: Keep HUD in the center
options.help: Keeps HUD elements in a centered 16:9 area with their original proportions. Off stretches the HUD across the window. Takes effect on the next launch.

options.label: Preserve menu framing
options.help: Returns the map, title screen and other non-gameplay screens to their original 16:9 presentation. Takes effect on the next launch.
